name: Pantheon Poker
detailed_description:
Pantheon Poker reinvents Texas Hold ’em as a mythology-themed digital card game. Play each hand with 4 random suits, each with unique mechanics that shift strategy and tactics every time. Use a powerful AI-powered luck mechanic to bend odds in your favor and outwit your opponents.

Pantheon Poker blends the competitive depth of Texas Hold ’em with the creativity of deck-building games like Dominion. While the core poker rules remain—betting on who can make the best hand—the suits are where things change. Instead of the traditional four, each game draws from a pool of special suits, each inspired by a different mythological tradition. From Norse to Greek to Egyptian gods, every suit introduces new rules and card powers, creating a fresh tactical puzzle in every hand.

At the heart of Pantheon Poker is a novel luck system powered by a custom AI model. Your cards and suit powers contribute to a luck stat, which subtly skews the probabilities in your favor. That means more favorable draws, stronger abilities, and clever ways to shift outcomes. Mastering this luck system is key to gaining the upper hand—and becoming a gambling god.

Whether you're a seasoned grinder or just looking for a fun twist on poker night, Pantheon Poker is built for all skill levels. Play casually or compete at high-stakes tables with deep strategic depth. Sophisticated AI opponents offer a welcoming space for new players to learn—and a formidable challenge for veterans looking to train and refine their edge.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64 Bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core 2 Duo E8200, AMD Athlon XE BE-2300, Snapdragon X Elite
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 5500 (Broadwell), AMD Radeon R5 Graphics (Kaveri)
